subject.title: fix(codex): keep OpenClaw exec when native surface has no environment (#92238)

question: Should direct/no-sandbox Codex app-server turns, including `/btw` side questions, restore OpenClaw `exec` and `process` when Codex has no turn environment?
rationale: The patch fixes a real regression, but it changes the shell exposure boundary for Codex app-server turns; automation cannot decide that execution-policy intent on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Confirm and merge the fallback
options.body: Accept the OpenClaw-owned shell fallback for direct/no-sandbox Codex turns and proceed with normal merge gates.

options.title: Require live hosted cron proof first
options.body: Keep the implementation shape but ask for an OAuth-backed cron run transcript or logs before merge.

options.title: Keep direct turns shell-less
options.body: Reject or close this direction if maintainers want Codex app-server shell access only when Codex itself supplies a native environment.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge the fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the OpenClaw-owned shell fallback for direct/no-sandbox Codex turns and proceed with normal merge gates.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server and side-question ownership history makes this the strongest available decision route.
